caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture, specifically a writing desk with an upper section of cubbyholes and small compartments. The main body of the desk consists of three front-facing drawers, each with a round pull handle and a centrally positioned keyhole. The upper portion of the desk features multiple small rectangular and square compartments of varying sizes, divided by thin wooden partitions, and two horizontal drawers with small pull knobs. The writing surface is green in color, likely felt or a similar material, and is shown in a horizontal position, supported by side runners extending from the desk. The desk as a whole is made from a light brown wood, with visible grain patterns, and stands on four legs with decorative cutouts at the base. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or embellishments.
title: Shaker Desk
